title: [BUG] Shift+Tab not switching to plan mode on Windows
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [x] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [ ] Other: <!-- specify -->
- Claude CLI version: 1.0.51
- Operating System: Windows 11
- Terminal:  Powershell 7.5.2

## Bug Description
After installing Claude Code on Windows, Shift+Tab fails to switch to plan mode.  

## Steps to Reproduce
1. run claude in vs code terminal
2. press shift+tab

## Expected Behavior
Pressing Shift+Tab should toggle between plan/code modes as documented.

## Actual Behavior
Pressing Shift+Tab does nothing - no mode switch occurs, and there's no visual feedback or error message.

## Additional Context
None
author: bukanpeneliti

top_comments.author: wen-da-ng
top_comments.body: Solution : If you're using Claude Code for VSCode, use "ALT + M".
